=== ✅ What You Did Well ===
Great job on completing your "Introduction to Data Analysis" project! It's impressive to see that you have managed to collect, clean, and analyze data using Python. The structure of your code is clear and easy to follow, which shows good organization skills. Additionally, your use of libraries like pandas and matplotlib demonstrates a solid understanding of data manipulation and visualization in Python.

=== ⚠️ Fixes & Suggestions ===
* In the `data_cleaning()` function, consider adding comments or documentation explaining what each step is doing. This will make your code easier to understand for anyone who might work with it in the future.
* When working with large datasets, there are some performance optimizations you could explore, such as using vectorized operations instead of loops where possible, and caching intermediate results when appropriate.
* For the visualization part, consider adding more details like axis labels, title, and legends to make your plots more informative and professional-looking.

=== 💡 Pro Tips to Go Further ===
* Experiment with different data transformation techniques, such as dimensionality reduction (e.g., PCA) or clustering algorithms (e.g., KMeans). These can help you gain a deeper understanding of your data and uncover hidden patterns or relationships.
* Try using other data analysis libraries like scikit-learn or TensorFlow for more advanced machine learning tasks, such as classification, regression, or neural networks.
* Explore interactive data visualization tools like Plotly Dash or Bokeh to create dynamic and interactive plots that allow users to explore the data in various ways.
* Work on a project that involves real-world data from a public dataset or an API, so you can gain experience with handling messy and complex datasets. Good luck in your future endeavors!
